disclaimer: Structured baseline for the admin Compliance Requirement Registry. This is not infallible legal authority. Northern Ireland private-rented detail, local authority forks, and workbook-only rows without a matching engine code were not invented — they are flagged for review. The live planner/materialiser still reads the in-code compliance_rules_registry only.
mapping_summary: Each bundle entry maps one workbook-aligned row to engine canonical_code plus scope_key for jurisdiction separation. Shared UK-wide codes (GAS_SAFETY, EICR, EPC, FIRE_DETECTION, LEGIONELLA) use scope_key DEFAULT with explicit display_jurisdictions. Wales occupation contract uses OCCUPATION_CONTRACT + scope WALES. Scotland landlord registration uses LANDLORD_REGISTRATION + scope SCOTLAND. HMO fire risk remains a single engine code with display limited to England/Wales/Scotland and NI applicability explicitly marked needs_review (workbook did not confirm NI HMO alignment). PDFs referenced externally (e.g. jurisdiction_matrix.pdf) were not parsed in-repo; no fields were inferred from them.
unmapped_workbook_rows: Workbook rows that referenced non-engine catalogue items (e.g. deposit protection, How to Rent, PAT) are not duplicated here until a canonical_code exists in compliance_rules_registry — add in a later bundle revision.
suspected_cross_jurisdiction_mixing: Engine buckets: Northern Ireland portfolio label normalises to ENGLAND_WALES scoring bucket — draft notes call this out for GAS_SAFETY / EICR / EPC; confirm product/legal before treating NI as identical cadence to England.
